defect: test-mode reset selection timing is unspecified
rationale: The reset source is selected combinationally by test_mode_i, but no constraint states whether mode changes occur only while the clocks and resets are quiescent; recovery/removal behavior at a live mode transition is therefore undecidable.

mutation.description: Reduced the reset generator to its functional/test reset selection boundary.

provenance.adaptation: Removed technology clock muxes and retained the selected-reset interface.

author: gpt-5.6-luna

labels.by: claude-sonnet (blind second labeller, design and constraints only)
labels.note: Async reset is a combinational mux of two resets that can glitch if test_mode_i changes; static test_mode is not constrained, and release is unsynchronised.
